subject: Final-week S5-to-S6 edit reaches the Recruit tier gate, not merely level 4
decision: No numeric XP grant or trigger is justified. Retain GAP-S5-HIDDEN-XP and GAP-S5-MISSION-REWARDS. The first Alia Das frame appears to be at the tier-2 eligibility gate; the earlier 10000-11000 estimate in bootcamp-s5-hidden-xp-audit-20260924.json only estimates the level-4 threshold, not the XP needed for the trainer-eligible state. Do not turn that partial estimate into a 1995 mission reward, an exit grant, or an automatic level top-up.
later_source_exclusion: docs/evidence/s5-s6-xp-source-exclusion-20260924.json: 1995 is still awaiting ordinary turn-in and 1526 is still an offer at first Alia Das view, after the observed XP jump. Their ordinary turn-in rewards cannot explain that earlier XP; a hidden objective/event, combat or transfer remains possible.

observations.confidence: high for displayed level, moderate for XP bar fullness because original frames are currently unavailable for reinspection
observations.source: docs/evidence/bootcamp-d11-footage-events.json, final-week video 8VXeKzGUv0c, B2-002 at 88.0 s; B2-015 through B2-018 at 98.4 s; docs/character-progression-client-evidence.md, Implementation section lines 244-255
observations.finding: The player is level 3 through the last boot-camp frame at 98.333 s, then level 4 at the first Alia Das frame at 98.400 s. The recorded frame audit says the experience bar stays full there. Chat already contains the level-up line tail and message 663, 'You will not advance in level until you visit a trainer and choose a new character class to advance in.' The cut omits the intervening actions.

observations.finding: Kincaid's Tier Advancement panel later shows Train bright when Soldier is selected. This is consistent with eligibility, but the recording does not show a completed class-change transaction.

observations.finding: The client receives a server-supplied training boolean. Its class-choice request requires that boolean, a living avatar and an immediate-child class. The client does not itself reveal the server XP threshold or the XP award source.

observations.source: /var/tmp/rasa-s6-after-v14-capture-20260924/char-after-rogers-turnin.db SHA-256 9333c3dd8dcdb88d516b511080c29d74f139eb996d9cc70fdfcc140403c9f5f4, SQLite read-only character and character_mission rows
observations.finding: The copied-client Rogers checkpoint completed 1990, 1992, 1994 and 1995, has Training Day 1526 active, and remains Recruit level 2 with 8695 XP. Its 1995 turn-in paid no XP; the current 1995/2005 seed has no reward rows, the S6 transfer has no XP action and Training Day seeds credits plus an item choice without XP.

numeric_reconciliation_using_emulator_ta.table_status: Emulator thresholds 10500 for level 3, 24000 for level 4, 43000 for level 5; not independently proved final-live values.
numeric_reconciliation_using_emulator_ta.filmed_character: The previous audit describes the pre-cut level-3 bar as roughly one quarter filled. Treating that as about 13875 cumulative XP gives about 10125 XP to level 4 and about 29125 XP to the level-5 tier gate. Both are rough scenario calculations, not original reward amounts or a reliable interval; unseen kills and an edited transition prevent assigning the delta.
numeric_reconciliation_using_emulator_ta.isolated_checkpoint: At 8695 XP, the copied checkpoint is 15305 XP below the emulator level-4 threshold and 34305 XP below the emulator Recruit tier gate. Its combat route and XP history differ from the filmed character, so these shortfalls cannot be backfilled as retail rewards.
